description:
Updates an issue resolution.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the issue resolution.
parameters.name: id

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The length of the description must not exceed 255 characters."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request isn't valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["You are not authorized to perform this action. Administrator privileges are required."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user doesn't have the necessary permission.

404.description: Returned if the issue resolution isn't found.
